description: This Java class 'EstabelecimentosDriver' acts as a test driver for integration testing of web application functionalities related to 'estabelecimentos' (establishments). It utilizes WebDriver for browser automation, providing methods to interact with form inputs, submit data, and assert expected page content for tests.

classes.name: EstabelecimentosDriver
classes.description: A test driver class providing methods to perform automated UI interactions and assertions for the Establishments functionality of the web application.

methods.name: abreListagem
methods.description: Navigates the WebDriver to the establishments listing page.

methods.name: adicioneEstabelecimento
methods.description: Fills out the form to add a new establishment with given name and address, then submits the form.

methods.name: ultimaLinhaDeveConter
methods.description: Asserts that the last row in the table contains the specified name and address.

methods.name: deveMostrarErro
methods.description: Checks that the error message appears on the page.

methods.name: adicioneEstabelecimentoComEstacionamento
methods.description: Adds an establishment with a specified parking availability.

methods.name: ultimaLinhaDeveTerEstacionamento
methods.description: Asserts that the last table row indicates whether parking is available.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Private helper returning the form WebElement.

methods.name: ultimaLinha
methods.description: Private helper returning the last row WebElement in the table.
